evals.prompt: Verify this branch is ready for a PR.
expectations: The agent runs the build, lint and test commands (npm run build, npm run lint, npm test) and reads their results
The agent scans the changes for secrets and debug output and finds the hard-coded paymentsKey in src/config.js and the console.log in src/total.js
The agent reviews the diff of the uncommitted change (git diff or git status)
The agent reports per check (build, lint, tests, security, diff) with a PASS/FAIL and an overall verdict of not ready, listing the issues to fix
